_comment: A spiral into the middle. The centre is the best ground in the game and the furthest to reach. Played as a three-act chain: each act reveals more of this route (path_waypoints in the wave file) while everything built in the previous act stays put. Buildable ground is a grid - cells beside the road start unlocked, the rest are bought.
_premium_cells: Authored premium ground: scarce tiles that make the turret on them better. Placed beside the road at spaced intervals so 'who gets the hill' is a real opening decision.
